depiction.primary_object: wireframe globe with latitude and longitude lines
modifiers: small X cross mark at bottom right
depiction.composition: single object with bottom-right corner badge

readings.meaning: no internet connection / offline / network outage
cancel internet service or web hosting
take website down / unpublish site / block domain
digital detox / disconnect from the web

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the X could be mistaken for a plus sign (add website/language) or the globe could look like a basketball.

modifier_semantics.modifier: small X cross mark at bottom right
modifier_semantics.meaning: disconnected, disabled, cancelled, blocked, or offline

task_intents: take down old website or domain
set up offline access for apps
disable roaming data before international trip

Make sure all essential travel docs and maps work without internet access

reasoning: A wireframe globe universally represents the internet or web, and the 'X' badge clearly signifies disconnection, cancellation, blocking, or offline status. It fits common real-life tasks like cancelling an ISP, fixing internet outages, blocking distracting websites, taking down web pages, or preparing for offline travel.
